subject.title: [Refactor] Consolidate synthetic log formats across MCP service pipelines

question: Should standalone MCP fatal diagnostics preserve adapter-specific prefixes, or should every adapter use one centralized synthetic-log envelope?
rationale: Both shapes are technically valid, but source inspection cannot determine whether the current component identity is intentional operator-facing context or accidental formatting drift.

options.title: Preserve adapter identity
options.body: Treat the current prefixes as intentional emitter context and close the cleanup unless concrete parser or support-tool drift is demonstrated.

options.title: Share a parameterized envelope
options.body: Extract a helper that accepts the adapter identity while preserving the current emitted bytes, then add focused tests for each caller.

recommendation.title: Preserve adapter identity
recommendation.body: Treat the current prefixes as intentional emitter context and close the cleanup unless concrete parser or support-tool drift is demonstrated.

likelyOwner.reason: The strongest available history signal is the recent shared CLI startup and stderr-routing work.
